ConnectionStrings.//Default: Documented here, never set here. In production App Service supplies it as a connection string named 'Default' of type 'SQLAzure', which surfaces as SQLAZURECONNSTR_Default and maps back to ConnectionStrings:Default. Locally, appsettings.Development.json points at the Docker container.

Acs.//Acs: Documented here, never set here. Production supplies these as App Service settings Acs__ConnectionString and Acs__SenderAddress (double underscore is the platform's nesting separator). Unset, AcsEmailSender logs a warning and reports a permanent failure rather than throwing - a developer without ACS credentials can still run the app.

VapidKeys.//VapidKeys: Web Push signing keys. Production supplies these as App Service settings VapidKeys__PublicKey / VapidKeys__PrivateKey / VapidKeys__Subject. PublicKey is served to the browser by design; PrivateKey is a secret. Rotating the pair silently invalidates every stored push subscription.

App.//App: Documented here, never set here. Production supplies BaseUrl as the App Service setting App__BaseUrl (double underscore is the platform's nesting separator). It is the absolute origin, no trailing slash, that password-reset links are built from - it cannot come from the request, because the outbox renders bodies at enqueue time and a worker retry has no request, and because a Host header is attacker controlled. Unset, the forgot-password handler logs an error and still answers normally, so a misconfiguration is a broken link rather than an account-enumeration oracle.

AdminSeed.//AdminSeed: Documented here, never set here. In production these come from App Service app settings AdminSeed__Email and AdminSeed__Password (double underscore is the platform's nesting separator), per infrastructure.md's secrets pattern. Locally, appsettings.Development.json supplies development-only values. If Password is empty the seeder logs an error and skips rather than failing startup - so an unseeded production app is a log line, not an outage.

TestDataSeed.//TestDataSeed: Documented here, never set here. Fills the database with a realistic test club (S-24) - 200 members, 2 admins, 2 trainers, passes, a schedule with bookings, exercises and plans - and runs ONLY in the Development and Staging environments, whatever these flags say. Azure supplies TestDataSeed__Enabled, TestDataSeed__Reset and TestDataSeed__Password as App Service app settings. Enabled seeds once, guarded on the admin1@example.test account; Reset first wipes every member, class, booking, pass, exercise and plan except the AdminSeed account, so turn it off again right after the reseed - left on, every App Service recycle wipes the environment. Password is the one password every seeded account shares, and a secret on Azure.
